scope: Review of one supplied model; no validation, exclusion or new theory is claimed. 'own' = independent code; 'repro' = Codex's checkpoint distribution re-integrated with our own integrals.

claims.label: D/C
claims.claim: Threshold XX->XX elastic cross section sigma = 2.16627561e-7/m_X^2 at lambda_X = 1e-3
claims.ours: 2.16627561e-7 (own; M = -4 lambda_X + 2(2 g m_X)^2/m_phi^2 = +0.0093333, sigma = |M|^2/(128 pi m_X^2)); contact-only 3.98e-8 (M1 lambda_X|X|^4) or 2.49e-9 (lambda|X|^4/4)
claims.note: phi exchange is 3.33x the contact amplitude with opposite sign; sigma_total/sigma_contact = 5.44; threshold amplitude accurate to 0.1 % at v = 0.068

claims.label: D
claims.claim: m_phi in M1 equals sqrt(6) m_X; the tilt leaves m_phi^2 = 2 lambda_phi v^2 unchanged
claims.ours: 2.4495 m_X = 0.22635 GeV; tilt second derivative zero at v; cubic 6 lambda_phi v -> 6(lambda_phi - eps) v (-6.7 %) does not enter tree XX->XX

claims.ours: 2.555e-6/m_X^2 (s-channel +0.020, t +0.00667, contact -0.004), 11.8x XX; pole at v = 0.577 c per particle; checkpoint Xbar fraction 4.8e-5

claims.label: A
claims.claim: The curve is a concrete conditional forecast that can be challenged, not yet a distinctive GRUT prediction
claims.ours: k = 1e5/Mpc is M_hm = 5.2e-3 Msun (0.041 Msun full-wavelength sphere); half-suppression k = 5.0e4/Mpc is 0.041 Msun; k = 1e4 is 5.2 Msun; current probes stop at k ~ 25-50/Mpc (M_hm 4e7-3e8 Msun: Lyman-alpha arXiv:1702.01764, satellites arXiv:2008.00022, lensing arXiv:1908.06983, streams arXiv:1911.02663); minihalo probes (PTA arXiv:2005.03030, 2012.09857; microlensing arXiv:1908.01773; 21-cm arXiv:1911.11144 to k = 80/Mpc) are O(1) in abundance
claims.note: 'not distinctive' confirmed; 'testable' corrected: a 10.7 % linear dip at 63 pc is not observable with any current or planned probe; shape is the standard mixed cold + warm signature (Boyarsky et al. 2009, arXiv:0812.0010)

claims.label: C
claims.claim: No 8-12 % step at Lyman-alpha scales; Lyman-alpha does not constrain the 6 % warm fraction
claims.codex: ratios differ from 1 by ppm at 1-10 h/Mpc
claims.ours: |dP/P| <= f k^2 <lambda^2>/3 = 1.4e-9 (10 h/Mpc), 1.3e-8 (30 h/Mpc); f = 0.059-0.070 below the mixed-DM thresholds (F_WDM < 0.35/0.6 arXiv:0812.0010; f < 0.16 at 1 keV arXiv:2504.06367); thermal-equivalent mass 1.9 MeV vs 5.3 keV bound

claims.label: C/A
claims.claim: 6.595 % of the charge in free X with v_rms = 0.0684 c at 2 MeV
claims.ours: 0.845 % direct Xbar emission from a supplied 10 % pulse x 7.37 catalytic chain at the supplied 20 MeV density (1695 Xbar -> 13189 X); Xbar emission ~ A^2.0-2.1; v_rms(20 MeV) = 0.66 c from the pulse's 2.3 % energy excess, /10 by redshift; eta_equivalent 0.934
claims.note: the fraction and temperature are supplied-input products (pulse amplitude A, clock T_f, reference Q), not model outputs; f scales ~A^2, lambda_fs ~ T_f, M_hm ~ T_f^3

claims.label: A/C
claims.codex: emitted plume mostly Xbar; checkpoint N_minus = -1.4e-13 (residual); late window 1.5 Xbar + 3.2 h per core per 1e4/m_X
claims.ours: Xbar fraction of the checkpoint gas 4.8e-5; the gas is a processed antiparticle plume; late source omitted from the transport

claims.label: E
claims.claim: Gas-core elastic scattering, omitted by Codex's transport (XX self-scattering only)
claims.ours: X at k = 0.068 m_X is excluded from the core interior (S^2 + 2 a F^2 - 1 = +0.40 m_X^2 at centre, edge 3.15/m_X); hard-sphere sigma = 160-265/m_X^2 for R = 3.6-4.65/m_X (1100-4000 for the 10-20/m_X tail); Gamma/H = 0.7-1.1e6 at 2 MeV vs 16 for XX; momentum decoupling at x = 830-1060, T ~ 3 keV; two-stage fluid toy: 0.89 at 1e5 unchanged, 0.32-0.73 at 3e5, 0.006-0.60 at 1e6 (phase dependent); post-decoupling free streaming 16-26 pc
claims.note: the decoupling temperature and the k >= 3e5/Mpc part of the curve are not robust within the model until the X-core elastic problem at k ~ 0.07 m_X is solved

corrections: Codex's sigma = 2.1663e-7/m_X^2 is the full tree amplitude (contact plus t- and u-channel phi exchange), not a contact cross section; the contact term alone is 5.4x (M1 convention) or 87x (lambda|X|^4/4 convention) smaller.

The 6.6 % free-X fraction and v_rms = 0.0684 c are products of a supplied 10 % pulse, a supplied 20 MeV density clock and a catalytic chain on cores (x7.4), not formation-ensemble results; f ~ A^2 and lambda_fs ~ T_f.

'Testable' should read 'unobservable at any current or planned sensitivity': the dip lies at 5e-3-5 Msun (k = 1e4-1e5/Mpc), 3.5 decades in k below present probes, and is the generic mixed cold + warm shape.
The XX viscosity-proxy decoupling at 0.62 MeV is not the gas's momentum decoupling: elastic X-core scattering (Gamma/H ~ 1e6 at 2 MeV, estimate) keeps the gas locked to the cores until T ~ 3 keV.
